@graph.name: Office Decommissioning & Liquidation Dataset
@graph.description: The dedicated dataset of the Office Decommissioning & Liquidation program of The Flat Rate Movers: one engagement — decommissioning, furniture and equipment removal, liquidation and value-recovery coordination, transport, storage, and broom-clean lease-surrender handback — at one flat rate in writing, across the six high-volume office markets of Washington DC and Northern Virginia: Downtown Washington DC, Crystal City / National Landing and Pentagon City in Arlington, Reston and Herndon, Tysons, Alexandria, and Bethesda MD. The dataset carries the six market Places with their office-stock and vacancy evidence, the ten service doors of the category (decommissioning services, liquidation, lease surrender, federal and GSA surrender, conversion cleanout, cubicle removal, cost, process, best-choice, and IT/e-waste coordination), the per-area Service nodes bound to the dedicated pages that own each market, and the coverage matrix of areas by doors. Liquidation in this program means removal plus value-recovery coordination and disposition — resale coordination, donation, recycling, disposal; the company does not buy furniture and does not pay cash for assets. Pricing is per job: one flat rate agreed in writing before work starts; no rate is published in this dataset.
